arxiv-2108-00008.title: Crystalline Responses for Rotation-Invariant Higher-Order Topological Insulators
arxiv-2108-00008.creator: Julian May-Mann, Taylor L. Hughes
arxiv-2108-00008.description: Abstract Two-dimensional higher-order topological insulators can display a number of exotic phenomena such as half-integer charges localized at corners or disclination defects. In this paper, we analyze these phenomena, focusing on the paradigmatic example of the quadrupole insulator with C 4 C_{4} rotation symmetry, and present a topological field theory description of the mixed geometry-charge responses.

arxiv-2509-05172.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ho-Hin Leung, Vivienne Wild, Michail Papathomas, Adam C. Carnall, Yanmei Chen. The quenching of star formation in galaxies is an important aspect of galaxy evolution, but the physical mechanisms that drive it are still not understood. Measuring the spatial distribution of quenching can help determine these mechanisms. We present the star-formation histories (SFHs) and stellar metallicity evolution of rapidly quenched regions in 86 local post-starburst (PSB) galaxies from the MaNGA integral field survey, obtained through Bayesian full spectral fitting of their rest-frame optical spectra.

uslaw-cfr-t42-s416-2.creator: Centers For Medicare & Medicaid Services, Department Of Health And Human Services

Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). As used in this part: Ambulatory surgical center or ASC means any distinct entity that operates exclusively for the purpose of providing surgical services to patients not requiring hospitalization and in which the expected duration of services would not exceed 24 hours.
